notes.title: Out Now - Language Patch and Free Playable Demo!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31720645/acd7cdcc82d34c789625b0a9fe60c90be5bf1d68.gif[/img]

[b]Forgotton Anne is now available with Russian, Portuguese, Portuguese-Brazilian, and Italian subtitles, and a free playable demo has just been released![/b]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/542050/Forgotton_Anne/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31720645/d6079eff51e7b5c9c035772e8c4a5228f9881da6.jpg[/img][/url]

The remaining languages - Polish and Spanish - will be rolled out in the coming weeks.

In addition to these languages, the patch features:

- Camera, Puzzle, and Platform Polish

- Multiple platforming behavior fixes

- and many minor polishes and bug fixes throughout the game

We hope you enjoy Forgotton Anne in your native tongue and if you haven’t played Forgotton Anne before, give the free demo a try. :)

As for our Japanese fans, we have a special treat planned for you later this year. Stay tuned!

We thank you from the bottom of our collective heart for your continued support.

notes.title: Forgotton Anne is out on Mac!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31720645/17dfb03457debcccfc7477545752960a0222a9e2.png[/img]As Forgotton Anne features traditional hand-drawn animations and oodles of visual art, many here at ThroughLine Games love working on Apple's Macintosh computers. It is for this reason we're stoked to announce that our labour of love, Forgotton Anne, can now be enjoyed on Mac through the Steam platform.

In addition to Mac Support, this update features:

- Updated camera logic

- Updated puzzle behaviour

- Increased platform visibility

- Multiple platorming fixes

- And many minor polishes throughout the game

We hope you enjoy Forgotton Anne on Mac and hope you'll take the time to tell your friends about it.
We thank you from the bottom of our collective heart for your continued support. :)
